name: speech-cyberpunk
about: Spoken dialogue, measured from 26 lines of one Cyberpunk 2077 character (the game's JALI lipsync layer) against their voice recordings. Jaw correlation with the game: 0.79.
source: Cyberpunk 2077 (measured numbers only; no game data is included)

notes.jaw_mean: loudness (dB after normalising) -> average jaw opening (0..1) at that loudness
notes.peakiness: 0 = follow the average, 1 = follow the peaks
notes.contrast: >1 snaps shut between syllables and opens wider on them
notes.normalize_to_db: the loud end (95th percentile of voiced frames) is shifted to this level
notes.open_lead_ms: jaw starts opening this long before the sound
notes.close_lead_ms: jaw starts closing this long before the sound stops
notes.follow_jaw: tracks that ride along with the jaw: value = gain x jaw
notes.shape_lead_ms: diction shapes run this far ahead of the sound
notes.symmetric: true = left and right always match (game dialogue does)
notes.upper_face: voice-driven blinks, brows, squints, gaze and head (see docs/PROFILES.md)

notes.blink_peak: how far a blink closes the lids (0..1)
notes.blink_in_pause: share of blinks moved into the nearest pause (within 0.7 s)
notes.brow_raises_per_minute: most brow raises per minute, on the strongest syllables
notes.brow_raise_threshold: a syllable needs at least this emphasis (loudness 0..1 + pitch) to raise the brows
notes.brow_lead_ms / brow_attack_ms / brow_hol: brow raise timing around the syllable
notes.pitch_weight: how much pitch (vs loudness) counts as emphasis; 0 skips pitch tracking
notes.frown_level: brows lower and eyes narrow up to this much on loud, low-pitched stretches
notes.loud_squint / loud_cheek: squint and cheek raise on loud passages (effort, singing)
